name: Origin Wars: Arena
storyline:
Before the Creators, the Originverse was null and void. There were no worlds and no civilisations, only the Keepers, unknown beings who guarded the emptiness. When outsiders from other universes showed the Keepers how beautiful those worlds could be, the Keepers entrusted them with the Ember Forge, an artifact that can create and destroy. These outsiders became the Creators.

With the Ember Forge, Creators shaped gods, heroes, villains, creatures and entire realms. Creation gave way to ambition, ambition to chaos, and chaos to war. Each Creator now wants to become the one true supreme being, and the power to create has become the power to destroy.

Creators never fight themselves. They battle through their Origins, living beings with their own will, backstory and personality, using a deck of 28 cards built around an archetype: Guardian, Trickster, Berserker or Tactician. Creators gather in factions of up to four, and the war is fought across many arenas for control of every realm. A Creator who is corrupted is erased by the Keepers, along with everything they made.

The fate of the Originverse now rests with the Creators.
summary:
Origin Wars: Arena is a competitive mobile action card game battler where players create original fighters called Origins from their imagination. Define your fighter's identity, powers, appearance and backstory, then transform that creation into a unique, balanced 28-card deck.

Challenge real players in ranked duels, private matches, party battles, factions and tournaments. Every battle rewards strategy, timing and skill.
